headline: Everything new since v1.80.0: Knowledge, local models, Agent Drafter and more
feat1: Knowledge bases: personal, agent-maintained knowledge with an interactive graph
feat2: Zero-setup local models: a bundled llama.cpp server runs open models offline
feat3: Agent Drafter: build ready-to-run agents and apps from a conversation
feat4: App SDK: capabilities, an encrypted vault, and human-in-the-loop approvals
feat5: Auto Visualiser: 33 interactive figure types rendered inline from your data
feat6: A first-class CLI: interactive TUI, lifecycle hooks, goals, and automations
feat7: Leaner and faster: memory-efficient core, jemalloc, and smaller binaries
feat8: One-click Restart and Update in place on macOS
